title: Bach — Menuet in G, BWV Anh. 116

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2013/01/06-77, Allen Garvin after Bach-Gesellschaft). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: LilyPond \tempo 4 = 125 in 3/4, G major. Two bar-checked \repeat volta 2 blocks of 16 and 24 bars (printed 40, which matches the MIDI; performed 16x2 + 24x2 = 80). Mutopia does not unfold them.

Third member of the anna-magdalena set with 04 and 05, and the one with UNEQUAL repeat halves — so performedBars is not just twice printedBars, which is exactly the arithmetic a count-only repeat check can get wrong.
Two \times 2/3 triplets in the second half, which is what the 1/12-quarter onset quantum exists for.
